items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 2:1
items.html: The existence of vessels begins from the time the light begins to expand from above downward, that is, from the Peh [mouth] of AK downward. Indeed, they are still not discernible; only afterwards, when the light returned from them to the Emanator and the vessels remained empty, is their coarseness discernible. (Chapter 1, Item 3)
